description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

AMERICAN SYSTEMS is hiring a Junior to Mid-Level Software Engineer to support a military training modernization program. The role develops and integrates software capabilities for an aircraft training suite, including simulation software, interface logic, and integration with external systems.
Software Engineer developing simulation software for trainer functionality, interfaces, and external-system messaging and integration

Responsibilities:
• Develop and implement simulation software in support of trainer functionality
• Create and maintain interface logic and supporting application components
• Support messaging, integration, and data exchange between trainer software and external systems
• Collaborate with software, systems, test, and hardware engineers to implement requirements and resolve defects
• Support software integration, build, installation, and verification activities in lab and trainer environments
• Participate in Agile development activities including sprint planning, backlog refinement, peer reviews, and status updates
• Analyze defects, troubleshoot software issues, and implement corrective actions
• Assist with technical documentation and software configuration management activities
• Support team collaboration tools such as Jira and Confluence
• Perform other duties as assigned

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Human-Machine Interface (HMI) Development, or related technical field; internships may be considered based on skills and experience
• U.S. Citizenship required for the purpose of obtaining and holding a Secret clearance
• 1–5 years of software development experience supporting interactive applications, simulations, trainer systems, or virtual environments
• Experience with Cameo Systems Modeler, MagicDraw, Rhapsody, or comparable tools supporting model-based systems engineering, SysML/UML, system architecture, requirements traceability, and lifecycle management for complex software-intensive systems
• Proficiency in one or more programming languages, frameworks, and development environments relevant to the program
• Experience developing real-time interactive applications or simulation software
• Ability to troubleshoot software defects and support integration in a team environment
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, written, and verbal communication skills
